name: Password
source:
You are Dave, a hyena who just finished his final year of schooling along with a few of his friends. What better way to end the school year than to spend it at an all expenses paid stay at a luxury mansion for a whole month? After all, after this month, everyone's going to be moving away to focus on their chosen paths in life, so this is the last time that everyone's going to be together for a long way.

Will romance flourish in the time spent isolated in a mansion, living the high life? Or is this all an elaborate ploy by someone pulling the strings at the mansion itself that just sees the group as a bunch of playthings for something much more sinister?

[From [url=https://passwordvn.itch.io/password]Itch.Io[/url]]
translation:
你是戴夫，一只鬣狗，刚刚和他的几个朋友一起完成了最后一年的学业。还有什么比在豪华豪宅里全费住宿一个月更好的方式来结束学年呢？毕竟，这个月之后，每个人都会离开，专注于自己选择的人生道路，所以这是最后一次大家长期在一起。

在与世隔绝的豪宅里过着奢侈的生活时，浪漫会蓬勃发展吗？或者这一切都是某个人在豪宅本身背后操纵的精心策划的策略，只是将这个组织视为一群更险恶的玩物？

[来自[url=https://passwordvn.itch.io/password]Itch.Io[/url]]
